US and China vie for AI influence amid risk management talks

The United States and China are engaged in a competition over artificial intelligence, focusing on AI models, chips, and supply chains. Simultaneously, both nations are exploring methods to manage the increasing risks associated with AI technology. Southeast Asia has emerged as a key area for their initiatives to establish international AI partnerships. The two rivals are preparing for an AI meeting where top concerns will be discussed.
